info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Campaign Management API
info.description: The Customer Campaign Management API provides businesses with tools to retrieve detailed information about customer campaigns. This API enables users to access valuable data regarding marketing initiatives targeted towards customers, aiding in campaign analysis and optimization. Typical consumers include marketing teams and data analysts seeking insights into campaign performance and customer engagement. Integration with this API can enhance decision-making processes and improve marketing strategies for better customer outreach.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific customer campaign by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a customer campaign using its unique identifier. It provides comprehensive information about the campaign, including its status, target audience, and marketing materials used.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving customer campaign management details for the specified campaign ID. Ensure that all required fields are correctly populated to receive the desired response.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the customer campaign details.

GetCustomerCampaignByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the customer campaign management operation identified by CUST-100045. It is currently defined as a simple string type.

targetSegmentId.description: Identifier for the target segment the campaign is aimed at.

channelMix.description: Array of channels used in the campaign.

items.description: Channel name used in the campaign.

startDate.description: The starting date of the campaign.

endDate.description: The ending date of the campaign.

campaignObjective.description: The main objective of the campaign.

controlGroupPercent.description: Percentage of participants in the control group.

contactFrequencyCap.description: Maximum number of contacts per participant during the campaign.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the campaign record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the campaign was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the campaign.

GetCustomerCampaignByIdResponse_200.description: Represents a marketing campaign with its associated details.

amount.description: The budget amount allocated for the campaign.

currency.description: The currency in which the budget is allocated.

Budget.description: Defines the budget details for a marketing campaign.

responseId.description: Identifier for the response related to the campaign.

correlationId.description: Identifier for correlating requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the campaign processing takes place.

Metadata.description: Contains additional metadata for tracking campaigns.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: The unique identifier for the endpoint that processes the request.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that is handling the request.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication scheme that uses Bearer tokens to allow secure access to protected resources. This implementation expects the token to be in the JSON Web Token (JWT) format.
